A board can be exported, generating a line of text which can be imported in external sites, like [Sudoku solutions](https://www.sudoku-solutions.com/)

::: {#cell-8 .cell}
``` {.python .cell-code}
b = Board(board)
b.export()
```
:::

:::

If I try to solve a puzzle which already contains an error, the solver fails:

::: {#cell-12 .cell}
``` {.python .cell-code}
# impossible
impossible_board = ['4--4----8', 
         '--9-1--7-', 
         '-23--54--', 
         '-----26--', 
         '-9--5--4-', 
         '--71-----', 
         '--24--39-', 
         '-7--6-5--', 
         '1-------4']
```
:::


::: {#cell-13 .cell}
``` {.python .cell-code}

```
